compatibility_basis.release_date_note: 1.7.0 changelog: a hotfix for WordPress 7.0 publishing-actions styling; previous stable 1.6.7 fixed script translations in WordPress 6.7.1. Neither release is reported as dropping support for WordPress 6.4.

identified_from.evidence: readme.txt 'Stable tag: 1.7.0'; classic-editor.php header 'Version: 1.7.0'; changelog entry 1.7.0 present
identified_from.limitation: This is the plugin's development repository, not the WordPress.org distribution, and it has no tags. The release reference is the WordPress.org SVN tag (see release_reference). The only difference between the package and this commit is one comment line in classic-editor.php.

release_reference.result: All six distributed files are identical (SHA-256) to the package; the file lists are identical in both directions.
release_reference.limitation: The SVN revision at which tags/1.7.0 was compared was not recorded, so the comparison cannot be tied to a specific revision and a later change to the tag could not be told apart from the state reviewed. The WordPress.org per-file checksums API could not be reached by the reviewer, so the SVN tag is the per-file reference. SVN and the download host are both operated by WordPress.org (one trust anchor).

verification_in_ci: download the exact source URL above
record the package SHA-256 (and compare with zip_sha256 once it is filled in)
check the plugin header version equals the pinned version
install it and run wp plugin verify-checksums against WordPress.org's published per-file checksums for that exact version
check the installed version equals the pinned version (C21-021)
record the Classic Editor settings used for the run (C21-022)
